title: Medha MCP Client Registry Schema (v1)
description: Declarative registry mapping the medha MCP server onto each AI coding tool's configuration file (cli/src/integrations/clients.json). Pure data: config paths, JSON dialect templates and launchers. No client-specific logic lives in code; the renderer interprets this file.

$schema.description: URI to this schema for editor autocomplete and validation.

serverName.description: Default key the server is registered under inside each client's server map.

launchers.description: How the server process is started. Keyed by launcher id (e.g. path, npx).

clients.description: One entry per supported AI coding tool.

template.description: A server-entry template. Strings starting with '$' are references ($argv, $argv[0], $argv[1:], $env, $serverName); every other string, number or boolean is a literal. Objects and arrays are resolved recursively, and keys resolving to an empty value are omitted.

path.description: A config file path. Either a single string (relative to the project, absolute, or ~-anchored to the home directory) or a per-OS map with a required 'default'.

argv.description: Program and arguments. Elements may contain the ${version} placeholder, substituted with the CLI version at render time.

env.description: Environment for the server process, exposed to templates as $env. Omitted from output when empty.

default.description: The scope used when no scope id is given. At most one per client.

container.description: Overrides the client-level container for this scope (clients whose scopes key servers differently).

format.description: Serialization format. 'literal' is reserved for clients whose config is not JSON (YAML/TOML); not yet implemented.

container.description: Deep path from the document root to the map of servers, e.g. [mcpServers] or [mcp, servers].

id.description: Stable identifier used on the command line (medha mcp config <id>).
